mentions.description: A Dungeons & Dragons combat tracker web app. Its latest feature lets users share custom monsters with the community so others can use them in their own encounters.

Latest feature is the ability to share custom monsters with the community so they can be used by others in their own encounters.

mentions.name: Top Of The Round
mentions.description: A free, beta-stage Dungeons & Dragons combat tracker for DMs that sits between Shieldmaiden and Improved Initiative in features/complexity. It surfaces the most important information at a glance — initiative order, health, conditions, and stat-blocks — while hiding extra depth behind buttons with keyboard shortcuts and a quick-access command palette (like macOS Spotlight or Alfred on Linux) for accessing more commands by typing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a Dungeons & Dragons combat tracker: "Top Of The Round".

For those DMs that use tools like these, my app sits between Shieldmaiden and Improved Initiative in terms of features/complexity.
